title: 工具窗单次与连续调试
question: 工具窗如何使用缓存输入并只执行当前模块？

current.condition: owner/solution/flow/node guards; no workflow or other tool busy
current.behavior: 会话捕获solution、flow、node和owner；execute delegate核当前状态后取缓存结果/调用输入，在scope lease中Task.Run NodeDebugExecutor。
Start锁内拒绝重入；单次克隆参数，连续每轮重新Snapshot并在Failed/TimedOut/Cancelled后退出，间隔是会话配置。

current.condition: enabled non-Group node; explicit compatible cached inputs
current.behavior: 只从显式缓存/订阅解析输入并克隆参数；构造仅一个节点的隔离流程交GraphExecutor，不执行上游生产者。

current.condition: current owner+solution; token not cancelled; session not disposed
current.behavior: 结果发布受owner/solution/session门保护，按solution/procedure/node身份保存，当前显示流程才恢复/刷新右侧。

current.condition: configuration/owner alive; selected node still exists
current.behavior: 这条普通配置执行路径捕获workflowSessions与configurationResults作为本次可用上游快照，再解析输入/参数；不经过ToolDebugSession.Start。

current.condition: isolated graph built; scope lease active
current.behavior: 构造单节点隔离流程直接Task.Run GraphExecutor，token来自ownerScope.Stopping；guard通过才发布configurationResults。这与另一个会话分支的debug CTS并非同一取消域。
